facts.text: PyFlyt/QuadX-Hover-v4 is registered with entry point PyFlyt.gym_envs.quadx_envs.quadx_hover_env:QuadXHoverEnv
The hover action is [vp, vq, vr, T]: angular velocity setpoints and thrust
The flight-mode-0 action space is a four-element Box with low [-pi, -pi, -pi, 0.0] and high [pi, pi, pi, 0.8]
The quaternion attitude space has 13 elements and the combined observation space has 13 + 4 + 4 = 21 elements
The hover observation concatenates body angular velocity (3), quaternion orientation (4), body linear velocity (3), ground linear position (3), the previous action (4) and the auxiliary state
The Aviary state is body angular velocity, ground angular position, body linear velocity and ground linear position
The QuadX auxiliary state is the throttle of each motor
Motors.get_states returns the throttle level of each motor
The hover environment defaults to flight_mode 0, flight_dome_size 3.0, max_duration_seconds 10.0, quaternion angle_representation and agent_hz 40
max_steps is int(agent_hz * max_duration_seconds) and env_step_ratio is int(120 / agent_hz)
The episode truncates when step_count exceeds max_steps
The episode terminates with reward -100.0 when the drone touches the floor or leaves the flight dome
Each step starts with reward -0.1; the dense hover reward adds 1.0 and subtracts the distance to [0, 0, 1], the roll-pitch angle and 0.01 times the square of the yaw rate
The base step sets reward to -0.1 before running the controllers
reset passes the seed to gymnasium.Env.reset and stabilises the Aviary for 10 steps
Aviary physics_hz defaults to 240 and physics_period is 1/physics_hz
Aviary.step advances updates_per_step = physics_hz / min(control_hz) physics steps
The QuadX control loop defaults to control_hz 120
The observation space is a Box with -inf/inf bounds and dtype float64

determinism.notes: reset(seed) and cap.world.seed.v1 fix the seed the environment records; the package fake returns a fixed start state and has deterministic kinematics, so the same seed and actions repeat a trajectory.  The upstream environment passes gymnasium's np_random Generator to the PyBullet Aviary, and the fake does not reproduce that random stream.

gaps: kinematic stand-in: positions and attitudes integrate the action without rigid-body forces, contact, collision response, drag or motor thrust curves; the upstream environment is a PyBullet quadrotor model (spec 05-fidelity F0)
no actuator, sensor, camera, wind or noise model; the four auxiliary values are the commanded throttle repeated, not measured motor states
the fake does not reproduce the upstream numpy random stream, the Aviary stabilisation steps or the PyBullet observation values; it was never compared with a real PyFlyt run
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by the declared timestep only
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state
the observation is the 21-element quaternion form; the upstream environment can also be configured with angle_representation='euler' (20 elements)

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
